summary: Plan project capacity, clarify ownership and resolve allocation conflicts. Explore the five-day course and strengthen your resource management practice.
lede: Project resource management covers estimating, assigning and controlling the people, skills and equipment a project needs. For project managers, coordinators and resource leads, this training develops practical skills in building role-based demand plans, mapping accountability with RACI, tracking availability in resource calendars, and resolving allocation conflicts through resource leveling and workload balancing.
audienceIntro: This course suits professionals who coordinate project work, assign specialist capacity or report resource constraints to project and functional leadership. It is designed for people with working familiarity with project schedules and team roles.
prerequisites: Working knowledge of project schedules, budgets and team roles is expected. No programming is required; familiarity with spreadsheets is useful.
